notes.title: Patch Notes - January 18th
notes.notes:
[h1]Achievements[/h1]
We’re very happy to now have Steam Achievements working in the game. We’ve made a list of 12, spread across Free Mode and Adventure. The full list is:
* Adventurer
* Ants in Pants
* Dino Lover
* Foxy
* Gardener
* Insomnia
* Janitor
* King of the Moles
* Sandbox Sensei
* Slow Clap
* Survivor
* Wacky Whacker

[h1]Other fixes and tweaks[/h1]
* Free Mode: Fixed flying and subterranean snails
* Free Mode: Fixed a bug where moths would spawn even though the species didn’t exist in your world
* Adventure Level 1: Fixed so you can’t remove world objects
* Adventure Level 9: Fixed so you can’t remove world objects
* Added rev number

notes.title: Patch Notes - January 10th
notes.notes:
Today we’re releasing a small update for Spirit. We are already at work with some bigger changes and more content to the game. But we wanted to quickly release an update that addresses some of the bigger issues we’ve seen:

[h1]Unlocking Free Mode[/h1]
At launch, the Adventure Mode unlocked Free Mode content. We have decided to get rid of this completely. All Free Mode content is now unlocked from the start, leaving Adventure to people that WANT to play through it.

[h1]Other fixes and tweaks[/h1]
* Free Mode: The game now always starts with your chosen animals/plants/minerals
* Free Mode: Snails now correctly spawn from rocks, even if the player moved the rock
* Adventure 1: Made the level more casual and quicker to play through
* Menu: Trees don’t mysteriously stop growing anymore
* Menu: Swapped Free Mode and Adventure GUI positions
* Menu: Changed release date from 2016 to 2017
